changes.title: Bounded reference-run budget and an explicitly FAILED report when a child times out; docstring/comments narrowed to what the code actually establishes
changes.kind: executable (identical to the first coauthor proposal); docstring and comments refined
refinements: Executable code carried over from the first coauthor proposal UNCHANGED - AST modulo docstrings and compiled code objects both identical (evidence/ast-code-comparison.txt, block A).
Docstring: 'SAME shape' narrowed - the report EXTENDS every previous key with per-entry timedOut plus top-level timedOut/childTimeoutSeconds, so it is a superset and NOT literally identical.
Docstring: 'no failure path' narrowed to the one path that was missing. Nonzero child exit and a changed/missing pin already had reporting; only a TIMEOUT had none.

Docstring: reportSha256 null now means NO COMPLETED RESULT IS ATTRIBUTED, explicitly not proof that no bytes were written - a child can be killed after writing, and an earlier run's report can be on disk.
Docstring: 600s stated as a bounded reference-run budget for this launcher only - not a product timeout, service level or authorization law, and not citable as one.

Comment: the aggregate of five child budgets is 3000s and bounds ONLY time spent waiting on children. It excludes the pin sweep, per-child process creation/teardown and the report write, so this file states no whole-run wall-time bound and no caller may derive one.
